routing_contract.when_to_use: Use when designing or restructuring general email lifecycle automation before writing the individual emails: a welcome onboarding series, an abandoned-cart or browse-abandon flow, a post-purchase / replenishment sequence, a light in-flow re-engagement branch, a B2B cold-outbound multi-step sequence, or the program's overall frequency governance and sunset policy. Activate when the user has a lifecycle stage, trigger event, or list-fatigue problem and wants the flow map, cadence, and branch/exit logic before creative or send-testing begins. Not for the closed-loop win-back / re-consent (re-permission) program on a defined lapsed cohort — that self-contained recovery-or-retire program is reactivation-specialist's.
